text: Here's the last 24 hours in geopolitics. In Iran, the US military launched defensive air strikes targeting Kesham Island, significantly escalating regional tensions and prompting an immediate international response. While the Parliament speaker declared that the ball is now in the US court, following recent American military strikes. In Ukraine, a massive Russian air strike targeted an aid center, killing 29 people, amid growing expectations for upcoming peace talks. In the USA, Donald Trump and JD Vance held final mid-term campaign rallies, claiming a deal with Iran will lower oil prices. In the UK, British troops received authorization to fire at Russian forces if attacked during their ongoing multinational mission deployment. In Nepal, a fatal aviation accident occurred near Mount Everest after two helicopters suffered a horrific mid-air collision during flight. In Yemen, intense fighting continues within the strategic Al-Jawf region between the official government forces and advancing Houthi rebel fighters. In Saudi Arabia, the upcoming Asian Cup soccer tournament was officially postponed until December due to persistent Houthi security threats. How will the US strikes on Iran impact global security?
